text:
maya: quick heads-up — I ran a 24h rehydration preemption sim against the new priority lanes (20% late-ingest profile) to validate the console preemption slider UX and scheduler heuristics. TL;DR: preemption cut peak slot contention ~35% but increased 95th tail for small tenants by ~18%.

sam: can you paste the sim command / flags?

maya: sure — used the local sim harness: ```./tools/rehyd-sim --policy=preemptable --preempt-threshold=0.6 --late-profile=20pct --slots=500 --seed=42```

jordan: nice. when you say "small tenants" which cohort? us-east small (<50 daily rehydrates)?

maya: yes — cohorts with slot quotas <= 8. bigger tenants saw improved median latency, small ones saw tail bump when preemption agressiveness > 0.6.

lucy: do we have any logs / example traces of preempted jobs? curious if retries are immediate or queued.

maya: replay-bot attached a short trace summary: 
replay-bot: "preempted=412, resumed=398, immediate-restart=122, backoff-retries=276"

raj: interesting — backoff-retries are the culprit. if a job gets preempted and backs off with jitter we push it to the tail. can we change the post-preempt behavior to expedite small-tenant jobs? maybe bypass backoff for <2 retries?

sam: that feels risky for fairness. small tenants might then thrash the scheduler. what about a soft expedite window (30s) that only applies when slot occupancy > 85%?

maya: i tried a variant: expedite-window=30s only if cluster_util>0.85 and tenant_quota<=8 — tail improved ~10% and fairness impact negligible in sim. config snippet: ```preempt_policy: { aggressive: true, expedite_window_secs: 30, expedite_condition: "cluster>0.85 && tenant_quota<=8" }```

jordan: UX question — how do we present this to users in console? slider currently maps to a single "preemptiveness" float. Operators will expect one knob, not multiple flags.

lucy: maybe keep 1 slider but show an advanced toggle that reveals "expedite small tenants" boolean with an explanation. default OFF for now.

maya: agreed. also, telemetry: we need a dashboard panel that shows preempt events, resumed count, and tail-latency by quota-cohort. otherwise we won't notice regressions.

sam: +1 for telemetry. can we reuse the "rehydration" dashboard? add a stacked bar: preempted/resumed per hour and a heatmap for 95th by cohort.

raj: operational safety: add a circuit-breaker that flips preemption to soft-fallback if small-tenant-95th increases >20% for 30m. sim showed that as a good threshold.

maya: action items: 1) eng-platform: add expedite-window flag behind advanced toggle in console (owner: lucy) 2) runtime: implement expedited restart path (owner: raj) 3) observability: add preempt/resume + cohort 95th tiles (owner: sam) 4) product: wording for slider + advanced tooltip (owner: maya)

lucy: will prototype the console change in the preempt-settings panel. mock in Figma first and then small A/B.

sam: I'll add the dashboard stubs and wire up alerts (circuit-breaker >20% 95th increase).

raj: I'll prototype expedited restart with a special immediate-lease for small tenants, keeping global fairness checks.

maya: thanks. one more ask — can we schedule a short run of the sim with realistic noisy late-ingest bursts (5x spikes) to sanity-check? if we see oscillations that's a red flag.

jordan: schedule it in the sim harness queue, suggest cron: Tue 03:00 UTC to avoid interference.

maya: booked it for Tue 03:00 UTC and tagged owners. will post results in this thread. :thumbsup:

sam: perfect. :rocket:
